title: Hook events: environment, config, files and worktrees
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: ConfigChange, CwdChanged, DirectoryAdded, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove.

hookEvent_ConfigChange.title: ConfigChange
hookEvent_ConfigChange.description: When a configuration file (settings, managed policy, skill) changes during a session.

hookMatcherGroup_ConfigChange.description: Matcher group for ConfigChange: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the configuration source. Values: `user_settings`, `project_settings`, `local_settings`, `policy_settings`, `skills`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_CwdChanged.title: CwdChanged
hookEvent_CwdChanged.description: When the working directory changes (for example after a `cd`).

hookMatcherGroup_CwdChanged.description: Matcher group for CwdChanged: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: CwdChanged has no matcher support: the field is accepted but silently ignored and the group fires on every occurrence. Omit it.

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.

hookEvent_FileChanged.title: FileChanged
hookEvent_FileChanged.description: When a watched file changes on disk. The matcher also builds the watch list.

hookMatcherGroup_FileChanged.description: Matcher group for FileChanged: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Literal filenames to watch, split on `|` (`.envrc|.env`), and also the filter applied to the changed file's basename. Regex patterns are not useful for the watch list. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`-separated list of exact strings (a hyphen, space or comma switches it to the regular-expression path and only `|` separates alternatives); any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression. Omit it on a group that only handles paths returned as `watchPaths` (matches every watched file, adds nothing to the watch list).
matcher.title: Matcher
